verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community report that users can delete their AngelList account themselves through Settings > Delete account. That is a real, product-owned deletion control. Nothing addresses retention settings, data-retention policy, granular data deletion, deletion of cap-table or company data, or deletion confirmation, and there is no first-party documentation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on deletion, configurable retention periods or policy, granular per-record or per-dataset deletion, and verification of deletion completeness.
